newsitem.title: USA: Wealthy businessman freed after being kidnapped.
newsitem.headline: Wealthy businessman freed after being kidnapped.

text.p: A wealthy businessman has been freed safely after being kidnapped Tuesday from his home in an expensive San Francisco neighborhood, police said.
Two suspects were in custody and a $500,000 ransom that was paid to the kidnappers for the businessman's release had been recovered, the police said.
Marshall Wais, an elderly businessman, was kidnapped from his home in the upscale Seacliff neighborhood of San Francisco, early Tuesday morning, according to local news reports.
Police and the FBI spent hours in negotiations with the kidnappers and a half million dollar ransom was paid.
The kidnappers released the businessman and minutes afterwards, two police cars rammed the kidnappers' van and officers arrested two suspects, KCBS radio said.
Wais was returned to his family safely, two suspects were in custody and the ransom money was recovered, a police spokesman said.
